questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: The first map was attractive, but several paths were marked in the wrong places. After the volunteers checked every route on foot, they produced a much ______ guide for visitors.
questions.solution: 语境把修改后的指南与第一版进行比较，且空前有much修饰比较级，因此用more reliable。
questions.title: 步道地图修订·多音节形容词比较级

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: When reviewing online claims, the less familiar a source is, the ______ students should be before sharing its content.
questions.solution: 本句使用“the+比较级，the+比较级”结构，表示来源越陌生，学生越应谨慎；be后需形容词比较级more careful。
questions.title: 网络信息核查·关联比较结构

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: The new water bottle is slightly ______ than the old one, yet its stronger material allows it to be used for many more years.
questions.solution: than明确引出两款水瓶的比较，slightly可修饰比较级，heavy的比较级为heavier。
questions.title: 耐用水瓶评价·不规则拼写比较级

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: According to the new timetable, the last bus to the science museum ______ at 6:30 every evening.
questions.solution: 句子说明时刻表规定的经常性安排，并有every evening提示，主语the last bus为单数，故用一般现在时leaves。
questions.title: 公交时刻表·一般现在时表安排

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: In the monitoring system, each of the sensors ______ a signal only when the soil becomes too dry.
questions.solution: 句子描述系统的一般工作规律，应用一般现在时；each of the sensors的中心词each为单数，谓语用sends。
questions.title: 土壤监测系统·一般规律与主谓形式

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question:
A report proposes opening the school roof garden at lunchtime. It notes that supervision and safe access must be arranged first. Which sentence best completes the report?

If these practical issues are addressed, ______ enough space for two classes to use the garden without crowding.
questions.solution: 空后是名词短语enough space，语义为“应当有足够空间”，应用there be存在句；情态动词should后接be，故选there should be。
questions.title: 屋顶花园报告·情态动词与存在结构

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: The survey shows that most residents support planting more street trees. However, ______ a question about who will care for them during long dry periods.
questions.solution: 语境表示“仍存在一个问题”，使用there remains...存在结构；真正主语a question为单数，所以用remains。
questions.title: 街道植树调查·there存在句与后置主语

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: The village archive is now available online. Before the photographs were digitized, ______ only one paper copy of each, so researchers had to travel there to see it.
questions.solution: 语境表示过去存在、现在已改变的情况，应用there used to be；其余选项结构不成立或主语指代不明。
questions.title: 村庄档案数字化·过去存在状态

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: ______ no reliable internet connection in the mountain station, the researchers saved the data locally and sent it after returning to town.
questions.solution: 主句结构完整，前半部分应为独立主格作原因状语；internet connection是“存在”的事物，there be的非谓语形式为there being，故选A。
questions.title: 山区数据传输·there be独立主格

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question:
An editor is summarizing a study that found a link between evening screen use and shorter sleep but did not establish cause. Which sentence is grammatically suitable for the cautious conclusion?

______ several possible explanations for the pattern, and further experiments are needed.
questions.solution: 语义为“存在若干可能的解释”，应用there appear to be；后置主语several possible explanations为复数，因此用appear。
questions.title: 睡眠研究结论·there appear to be结构

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: Before the weekly air-quality figures appear on the public website, every unusual reading ______ against data from a second instrument.
questions.solution: 句子说明固定审核流程，应用一般现在时；reading与check之间是被动关系，单数主语对应is checked。
questions.title: 空气质量数据发布·一般现在时被动
